text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur, what was that about earlier? 
Suddenly asking to borrow my phone like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I installed an app I built myself. See? 
That icon right there.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
..."Happy Birthday"? Huh, is this a 
birthday present?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's this? Amazing...! Four-leaf 
clovers are sparkling and spreading all 
over the screen...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've got light particles running on a 
program. This way, they'll never wither, 
and it saves us the trouble of going out 
to look for them, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Geez~ Even the time spent searching for a 
four-leaf clover becomes a happy memory, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I'm super happy with this 
clover too! I'll cherish this souvenir 
clover from you, Shakur♪"
